decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before 15/04/2019.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ((SK) 007 Rev C, (SK) 008 Rev C (SK) 019, (SK) 020, (SK) 021, (00) 016 received on 03/02/2016. Design and Access Statement produced by GSS architecture, Planning Statement Reference 1084 dated January 2016, Travel Plan Framework produced by Intermodal Transportation dated January 2016, Transport Statement produced by Intermodal Transportation dated January 2016, Construction Phase Plan CPP WD/DB produced by Farrans dated 5th January 2016, Drainage Assessment Forms dated 8th January 2016, Drainage Assessment Forms dated 27th January 2016,  Phase 1 Desk Study and Preliminary Geoenvironmental Assessment 7047/G/01 produced by WML Consulting dated December 2015 received on 03/02/2016. (00)02_24/09/2015 received on 24/03/2016. Energy Statement produced by AECOM received on 24/03/2016. All approved under reference 01145/F/P21. Plans reference (SK) 000 rev B, (SK) 007 Rev D, (SK) 009 Rev B,  (SK) 010 Rev C, (00) 015 Rev A, (00) 016 Rev A received on 21/06/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for a school and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the commencement of development, a landscape strategy and management plan, including details of any existing planting to be removed or retained, landscaping detailing, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas, shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the development for its permitted use.
Any trees or shrubs planted which die within five years of completion of the development shall be replaced with the same species, and of comparable maturity, or an approved alternative. The landscape strategy and management plan shall be carried out as approved and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 7 - Prior to commencement of development a tree protection plan relating to any retained trees shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the Phase 1 Desk Study and Preliminary Geo-Environmental Assessment ref 7047/G/01 dated December 2015 produced by WML Consulting and received on 22/06/2016. Asbestos Materials Survey ref AEC150812/1 dated 12/08/15 produced by Archway Environmental Consultants received on 25/08/2016. Letter ref 774064-LET-ENV-002 dated 22/08/2016 produced by MLM Consulting Engineers Ltd received on 08/09/2016, approved under reference 01145/F/P21(8).
During the course of the development:
i. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use:
ii. The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 9 - A Construction Logistics and Management Plan shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of development. The plan shall cover the following: 
i. a site plan 
ii. confirmation that a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway will be undertaken with Hounslow Highways and a commitment to repair any damage caused 
iii. provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors 
iv. provisions for loading, unloading and storage of plant and materials within the site 
v. details of access to the site, including means to control and manage access and egress of vehicles to and from the site for the duration of construction including phasing arrangements 
vi. the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate 
vii. provision of wheel washing facilities at the site exit and a commitment to sweep adjacent roads when required and at the request of the council 

viii. measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction 
ix. a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works 
x. details of appropriate vehicle routes to and from the strategic road network 
xi. Safety measures and strategy to segregate school pupils and construction vehicle route to minimise risks of conflicts during its construction phase 
xii. the contractor's compound 
xiii. measures to ensure the safety of all users of the public highway especially cyclists and pedestrians in the vicinity of the site and especially at the access 
xiv. a commitment to liaise with other contractors in the vicinity of the site to maximise the potential for consolidation and to minimise traffic impacts. 
xv. avoidance of peak hours for deliveries and details of a booking system to avoid vehicles waiting on the public highway 
xvi. Noise Mitigation measures in accordance with best

Condition : 10 - Prior to occupation of the building, a Travel Plan that includes proactive targets, measures and an action plan to reduce car travel, particularly car borne staff trips and targets for modal share shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The travel plan shall be put into effect when the development is first occupied.

Condition : 11 - Prior to the commencement of development, a Car Park Management Plan, including confirmation and location of the 22 allocated spaces, as well as proposals to provide alternatives to prevent on-street parking, including a review mechanism and mitigation and allocation of spaces for visitors, shall be submitted to and approved by 
the Local Planning Authority and shall be put into effect when the development is first occupied.
Condition : 12 - Prior to 1st September 2017, the temporary building, hardstanding and fencing hereby approved shall be removed from the site and the ground returned to grass.

Condition : 13 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and shall not commence above ground until full Design Stage calculations under the National Calculation Method have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local planning Authority to show that the development will be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the National Calculation Method should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
Condition : 14 - The northern access to the site shall be entry only, and the southern access to the site shall be exit only.

Condition : 15 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with plan no. (90) 005 Rev A received on 22/06/2016, approved under application 01145/F/P21(15).

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and the facilities shall be so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 16 - Prior to the occupation of the development the shower and changing facilities shall be provided as shown on plan reference (SK) 008 Rev C received on 03/02/2016, and made available for use during the operating hours of the school. The facilities shall be so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 17 - Details of any external lighting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of the development hereby approved.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and so maintained at all times thereafter.
description: Variation of condition 3 to amend approved drawings to allow installation of external  plant store following planning permission 01145/F/P21 dated 15/04/2016 for proposed retention of temporary modular buildings for one year and demolition of an existing single storey classroom extension and erection of a replacement two storey extension, infilling of ground floor walkway to the rear and installation of additional windows to an existing teaching block for use by the Logic Studio School.
